input: The James Webb Space Telescope launched on 25 December 2021 aboard an Ariane 5 rocket from Kourou, French Guiana. It operates near the second Sun-Earth Lagrange point, about 1.5 million kilometres from Earth. Its primary mirror is 6.5 metres across and is made of 18 hexagonal gold-coated beryllium segments.
